args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on a label mix-up that's been causing confusion on the Coastal side:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That older label is why people are searching twice for the same account.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so the shorthand alone is ambiguous. Use the full name where you can.
- Could the saved report label be updated to Pellow Home Living? Sofia's team will check tomorrow's export once it's changed.

Thanks,
Sofia

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on a label mix-up on the Coastal side:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", which is why people search twice for the same account.
- "PHL" is also used for a second business, so the shorthand alone is ambiguous:
  - The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows (Pellucid Harbor Logistics).
  - The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments (Pellow Home Living).
- Could the saved report label be updated to Pellow Home Living? Use the full name where you can until then.

Thanks,
Sofia
